title: Choose the sanitizer for the failure

cast.name: Nia
cast.role: Junior developer who wants one sanitizer flag for every bug

cast.name: Len
cast.role: Staff engineer who maps each bug to the right instrument

glossary.note: Finds many out-of-bounds and use-after-free memory errors.
Checks selected undefined operations during execution.
Detects data races in instrumented executions.

key_points: AddressSanitizer targets memory errors; UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer targets selected undefined operations.
ThreadSanitizer targets data races and normally needs a separate build.
Sanitizers add runtime and memory overhead; test representative paths and measure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Triage brings three reports: a stale pointer, suspicious arithmetic, and two threads racing over one counter.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: Can one sanitizer catch all three? I need a quick debug build, not a pile of switches.

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: AddressSanitizer instruments memory accesses to catch many out-of-bounds and use-after-free errors. It costs memory and runtime; reports cover executed paths.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: That covers the stale pointer. Does it find signed addition beyond its range?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer checks selected undefined operations, including signed integer overflow. It reports only when a checked operation executes.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: And the shared counter? What report should I expect?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: For the counter, use ThreadSanitizer. It detects data races. Clang documents it cannot be combined with AddressSanitizer in one build.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: Choose by symptom: memory access, undefined operation, or unsynchronized shared state. These tools answer different questions.

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: Run AddressSanitizer with UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer on representative tests; use a separate ThreadSanitizer build for races. They cost resources; clean runs cover only exercised paths.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: I will match the tool to the failure and test dangerous paths. No single clean run certifies the program.

expect.note: The note captures the main reveal.
